tools.name: measure_context
tools.description: Use when CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, Cursor rules, or prompts may be too large or consuming too much context. Input: optional suggest, stale, and staleGlob booleans. Returns JSON token totals, per-file counts, baseline deltas, budget status, suggestions, and optional stale-reference findings. Runs offline and only reads the current working directory.

tools.name: context_budget_plan
tools.description: Use before appending more than ~50 lines or when CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, Cursor rules, or prompts exceed budget. Input: required integer budget plus optional maxFindings, includeDiff, and apply. Returns a deterministic ranked plan with file line ranges, tokensFreed, confidence, safety actions, preserve spans, and satisfiable/minAchievable stop state. Apply entries in order by startLine/endLine, never rewrite a file, never cut preserve spans except by applying the condensedText of a condense entry exactly as given, stop when satisfiable is false, and call context_budget_verify after edits. The plan is saved under .ctxcap/plans for 24 hours.

tools.name: context_budget_verify
tools.description: Use after applying a context-budget plan to catch missed edits, manual drift, or preserve-span violations. Input: the planId returned by context_budget_plan. Returns applied and missed finding IDs, violations with file and line ranges, remaining tokens, and satisfied. Do not consider the budget met until satisfied is true.

tools.name: trim_to_budget
tools.description: Deprecated alias for context_budget_plan for clients using the old name. Input: required integer budget and optional maxFindings. Returns the same ranked, safety-classified plan with apply false; it never edits context files. Follow line ranges, preserve spans, satisfiable stop rules, and verification guidance from context_budget_plan.
